en.summary: A podcast explains how to properly interpret and contextualize statistical claims in headlines, such as statements about doubled risks or probability figures.

en.summary: A politician from the Left party has relinquished his position on the interior committee.

en.title: Football national team: Schlotterbeck may be out again
en.summary: National player Nico Schlotterbeck has apparently sustained a foot injury during national team training, and his participation remains uncertain.

en.title: Middle East: Israel: Attempted attack on Flydubai flight to Tel Aviv
en.summary: An attempted attack occurred on a Flydubai flight headed to Tel Aviv.

en.title: Violence against train staff: Federal government plans stricter penalties
en.summary: The German government is proposing enhanced protections for railway and health workers against assaults, with minimum sentences of six months imprisonment for attackers.

stories.title: Flydubai: Gewalt an Bord – Mann mit Messer auf Flug nach Tel Aviv überwältigt

en.title: Flydubai: Violence on board – man with knife on flight to Tel Aviv overpowered
en.summary: A passenger wielding a knife attacked the captain during a flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv, but was subdued by other passengers and the aircraft landed safely in Saudi Arabia.

stories.title: Fußball-Nationalmannschaft: DFB-Verteidiger Schlotterbeck verpasst Länderspiele wegen Knöchelverletzung

en.title: Football national team: DFB defender Schlotterbeck misses international matches due to ankle injury
en.summary: Nico Schlotterbeck sustained a lateral ligament injury to his right ankle during training and will be unavailable for upcoming matches against Serbia and Greece.

stories.title: Kurz vor Exekution: Gericht stoppt Hinrichtung einer Frau in Tennessee

en.title: Shortly before execution: court halts execution of woman in Tennessee
en.summary: A Tennessee court intervened to stop the execution of a woman scheduled for Wednesday, which would have been the first female execution in the state in over 200 years.

stories.title: Hinrichtung in Tennessee: Gericht stoppt Hinrichtung von Frau im US-Staat Tennessee

en.title: Execution in Tennessee: Court stops execution of woman in US state Tennessee
en.summary: A court halted the execution of Christa Pike in Tennessee shortly before it was scheduled to proceed. Pike had been convicted of murdering a classmate when she was 18 years old.

en.title: Raid over money laundering network linked to "Hells Angels"
en.summary: Police conducted early morning raids on apartments across multiple German states and in European countries targeting an international money laundering network connected to the Hells Angels motorcycle gang.

stories.title: Razzia Gegen Hells Angels: Das System hinter der Kutte

en.title: Raid Against Hells Angels: The system behind the patch
en.summary: High-ranking Hells Angels members allegedly worked with a money laundering network operating across Europe. Selo A., described as the most powerful member of the motorcycle club in Duisburg, was among those arrested.

stories.title: Pläne der Bundesregierung - Härtere Strafen für Angriffe gegen Einsatzkräfte

en.title: Federal government plans - Stricter penalties for attacks against emergency personnel
en.summary: The German federal government plans to increase penalties for attacks on emergency responders, paramedics, train staff, and other public servants, as such attacks have risen in recent years.

stories.title: Märkte Insight: Anleihen sind attraktiv geworden – aber nicht risikofrei

en.title: Markets Insight: Bonds have become attractive – but not risk-free
en.summary: Bonds across different maturities are now offering competitive returns. However, investors seeking to limit risk should consider factors beyond yield alone.

en.title: DAX currently: DAX closes in the red after inflation data – Commerzbank stock biggest loser
en.summary: Oil prices increased as inflation data triggered speculation about interest rate policy in the United States. The bond market showed some relief during the session.

en.summary: According to the Israeli government, a Boeing 737 en route to Tel Aviv narrowly avoided disaster when one pilot stabbed a colleague during the flight.

en.title: Energy: A company is pulling down the gas storage average – even though it should be filling storage
en.summary: The government is relying on the gas storage operator with the lowest fill levels to help the country through winter. A distribution board member discussed this strategy at an industry event.

en.title: Commentary: Andy Burnham's Revolution Is Also a Recipe Against Right-Wing Populism
en.summary: The British Prime Minister is implementing a threefold shock therapy for the country. The commentary suggests other politicians could follow this approach as a model against right-wing populism.
